- Initial release: Provides a fully offline prohibited words scanner and maintainable wordlist for Xiaohongshu content.
- No paid API dependency; all checks run locally to guarantee reliability at publishing.
- Enforces publication blocking on P0-level words; supports regular wordlist maintenance with clear in/out procedures.
- Designed as the single source of truth for prohibited word checks—other skills (like free-course-share and xiaohongshu-content-workflow) integrate directly.
- Includes usage instructions for both content scanning and wordlist updates.
